card.name: Words just before sedation or drowsiness terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or partway through words right before an expected sedation term such as drowsiness, somnolence or sedation, mostly in sedative drug labels. Also fires on linking words in drug-interaction phrases like 'ethinyl estradiol or levonorgestrel'.

modes.label: Before sedation words
modes.description: A linking word or word start where 'sedation', 'drowsiness' or 'somnolence' is expected next.

modes.label: Inside somnolence
modes.description: The first piece of the word somnolence.

modes.label: Drug interaction wording
modes.description: Linking words or word ends in lists of drugs or metabolites in interaction text.

card.writes: It suppresses alcohol and drunkenness words, so it steers the output away from alcohol terms in favor of sedation wording.
card.plain: It marks spots where a sedation or drowsiness word is about to come, and it pushes away alcohol words.
